title: Troubleshoot Forwarder TLS and Certificate Failures
track: Forwarders, Deployment Server, and Heavy Forwarders
objectives: Troubleshoot Forwarder TLS and Certificate Failures
Verify actual configuration, delivery and resulting operational behavior.

tasks.instruction: This isolated attempt starts paused. Use Forwarder Management to inspect clients/apps/classes, or Terminal SSH from the bastion. Linux UF: ssh splunk@lab-lnx-0001. Automation: ssh svc_ansible@ansible01 then cd ~/splunk-automation. Administrative changes and packages are entirely simulated.

The encrypted receiving port is available, but the canary trusts the wrong CA. Inspect the explicit teaching certificate/CA metadata and outputs.conf. Replace its CA file using /opt/staging/v7-correct-ca.pem, keep sslVerifyServerCert=true and sslCommonNameToCheck=idx01.corp.example, restart the canary and verify list forward-server. Advance time and query the two canary records. Certificate relationships are simulated metadata checks; no real PEM cryptography is performed. Disabling verification must not pass.

After the required activation, select the client in Forwarder Management and use Advance simulation 60 seconds. Inspect btool/forwarding output and independent Search as required. Record the evidence answer; an answer alone cannot complete the exercise.

hints: Distinguish staged source, published catalog, downloaded app and running configuration.
Use a narrow target and the component that owns the change. Inspect failures before retrying.

references.purpose: Predict changes, apply and verify idempotency

checks.label: Independent search finds only the explicit teaching records

setup.text:
practice_id=v7-canary-001 status=200 service=ops
practice_id=v7-canary-002 status=500 service=ops

[monitor:///var/log/practice/forwarder.log]
index = os
sourcetype = v7_forwarder
disabled = false

[tcpout]
defaultGroup = v7_receiver
[tcpout:v7_receiver]
server = idx01.corp.example:9998
useSSL=true
sslVerifyServerCert=true
sslRootCAPath=/opt/splunkforwarder/etc/auth/v7/ca.pem
sslCommonNameToCheck=idx01.corp.example
sslVersions=tls1.2

questions.prompt: Which verification flag must remain enabled?

feedback.success: Verified real simulated source, delivery and operational outcomes.
feedback.incomplete: Inspect component scope, activation, actual phone-home, latest run and independent search results.
